acquisition_method.evidence: The MS analysis was performed in a data-dependent manner with full scans (m/z 300–1400) acquired using an Orbitrap mass analyzer at a mass resolution of 120,000.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Tryptic peptides were dissolved with 10 μl of loading buffer (5% methanol and 0.1% formic acid), and 5 μl was loaded onto a homemade trap column (2 cm) packed with C18 reverse-phase resin (particle size, 3 μm; pore size, 120 Å; SunChrom, USA) at a maximum pressure of 280 bar with 12 μl of solvent A (0.1% formic acid in water).

collision_energy.evidence: All the tandem mass spectra were acquired using the higher-energy collision dissociation (HCD) method with normalized collision energy of 27%.

enrichment_method.evidence: Distinct isoforms of CCAR1 were immunoprecipitated with Protein A-G agarose from A549 cells stably expressing Flag-CCAR1L and Flag-CCAR1S with endogenous CCAR1L/S depleted.

fragmentation_method.evidence: All the tandem mass spectra were acquired using the higher-energy collision dissociation (HCD) method with normalized collision energy of 27%.

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: The samples from in-gel digestion were analyzed on a Q-Exactive HF MS (Thermo Fisher Scientific) interfaced with an Easy-nLC 1,200 nanoflow LC system (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
